parameters.name: AccountName
parameters.description: This parameter is used only for vertical partitioning. It specifies the name of an account that has access permissions on the corresponding databases across all RDS instances in a vertical partitioning scenario.

parameters.name: DbInstType
parameters.description: The type of the attached storage. Currently, only RDS is supported.

parameters.name: DbInstanceIsCreating
parameters.description: Specifies whether the RDS instances involved in database creation are being created.

parameters.name: Encode
parameters.description: The encoding used by the database.

sub_parameters.name: DbInstanceId
sub_parameters.description: The ID of the RDS instance to be vertically partitioned. This parameter is used only for vertical partitioning.

parameters.name: Password
parameters.description: The password used to access the database.

parameters.name: RdsSuperAccount
parameters.description: The list of RDS superuser account information.

sub_parameters.name: AccountName
sub_parameters.description: The name of the RDS superuser account.

sub_parameters.name: Password
sub_parameters.description: The password of the RDS superuser account.

parameters.name: Type
parameters.description:
The sharding method of the database. Valid values:

- **HORIZONTAL**: horizontal sharding, which is commonly known as table and database sharding.
- **VERTICAL**: vertical partitioning.
